# A component var of funcvar type that receives both a sync and an async
# candidate at different call sites. The slot is auto-promoted to Async (g3)
# so the invocation handler awaits unconditionally.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# The "Run" handler wrapper is async because the handler slot may hold async.
grep 'addEventListener.*async function' out/index.html

# The funcvar call site on the promoted-async slot is awaited.
grep 'await state\.handler()' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"
import api "js:./api"

func syncFetch() string {
    return "sync"
}

component main {
    var handler func() string = api.fetchHello
    button(text="UseSync", @click { handler = syncFetch })
    button(text="UseAsync", @click { handler = api.fetchHello })
    button(text="Run", @click { handler() })
    text(value="hi")
}

-- api/index.ts --
export async function fetchHello(): Promise<string> { return "hi"; }
